_readme: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the workshop. Edit here and every page, the poster, the QR codes, the calendar files, the JSON-LD and the social cards update on the next build. Field notes are in docs/EDITING.md.
name: The Incredible Tapestry
title: The Incredible Tapestry: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts Together
tagline: Weaving the Steps, Traditions & Concepts into One Fellowship
description: A free, all-day online A.A. workshop on Saturday, December 12, 2026 (8 AM – 4 PM Pacific) exploring how the Twelve Steps, Twelve Traditions and Twelve Concepts intertwine — one number at a time, all three legacies side by side. On Zoom, with ASL and Spanish interpretation.

event.name: The Incredible Tapestry Workshop
event.cost: Free. There are no dues or fees; we are self-supporting through our own contributions (Seventh Tradition).
event.audience: Open to all A.A. members, trusted servants and anyone curious about the three legacies. Newcomers warmly welcome.

registration.note: No registration needed — just join the Zoom meeting.

interpretation.label: ASL interpretation
interpretation.labelEs: Interpretación en ASL (lengua de señas americana)
interpretation.note: American Sign Language interpreters will be on screen all day. Use Zoom's sign language interpretation view or pin the interpreter.

interpretation.label: Spanish interpretation
interpretation.note: Choose the Spanish channel from the Interpretation (globe) button in Zoom.

zoom._readme: Also editable from GitHub → Actions → 'Update Zoom info' without touching this file.

event.recording: Not recorded. In keeping with our tradition of anonymity, this workshop will not be recorded.

legacies.name: Recovery
legacies.source: Alcoholics Anonymous (the Big Book) and Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions
legacies.blurb: The Steps are how the individual alcoholic gets well: a spiritual program of action, one day at a time.

legacies.name: Unity
legacies.source: Twelve Steps and Twelve Traditions and A.A. Comes of Age
legacies.blurb: The Traditions are how the group stays well: the hard-won lessons that keep us together so the hand of A.A. is always there.

legacies.name: Service
legacies.body: The Twelve Concepts for World Service
legacies.source: The A.A. Service Manual / Twelve Concepts for World Service
legacies.blurb: The Concepts are how the Fellowship as a whole stays well: the principles that let our service structure carry the message worldwide.
